verdict.rationale: stagewise lets a user connect several local project folders as workspaces and generates a WORKSPACE.md for the agent's understanding. Nothing in the evidence shows building a workspace from docs and repos that is shared with a team as a common source of truth. Local multi-folder workspaces and enterprise SSO/SCIM are adjacent features and do not deliver team-shared workspaces.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
